subject: 少林寺初祖庵 · 初祖庵大殿正面
author: Robinlun
source_note: 主图为Robinlun于2013年实拍，2024年另一角度补核屋顶。保留三间四柱与中央门、两侧窗。
prompt: Make a museum architectural line plate of Chuzu Temple's 1125 main hall, Dengfeng. First Longmen image is LINE STYLE ONLY. Second photo shows the FRONT facade of this specific hall; third shows its rear/side and is supplementary evidence for the roof and bracket geometry. Draw the FRONT, not the rear. Exactly THREE front bays defined by FOUR carved octagonal stone columns, with a central doorway and matching barred timber windows in the two side bays as in front photo. Stone columns are visibly faceted and carry a few incised decorative contours, not generic round columns. One single hip-and-gable roof, deep broad eaves, large Song dougong with strongly projected arms. Obtain the roof silhouette and curled up corner/end-ridge ornaments from the third image while retaining the front doors/windows from the second. Low broad terrace with central flight of plain stone stairs; no balustrade. Remove trees, branches, leaves, incense burner, monuments, people, all lettering and clutter. Whole building and roof corners must fit with 8% side margins. Landscape 1536x1024, straight frontal composition. PURE white background, delicate precise fine BLACK lines, no color, no tonal shading, no crosshatching, no solid black windows, minimal brickwork, sparse tile strokes, much open white. Quiet airy contour density like the master.

site_recommendation.name: 少林寺初祖庵
site_recommendation.lede: 石柱撑起深远的木檐，初祖庵大殿以小小三间保存宋代营造的层次。柱身雕刻与硕大的铺作，使这座纪念达摩的庵院有了独特面貌。
facts: 大殿建于北宋宣和七年（1125），属于登封“天地之中”世界遗产的少林寺建筑群。
三间单檐歇山顶，以雕刻石柱承托木构，柱头斗栱体量突出。
图版以前立面为主体，参考另一角度核对屋面；只收初祖庵一处，不将少林塔林拆分计数。
